summary.intent: Resolve PR review threads on encryption/upload code, then run web E2E tests against local UI with staging API, and fix a Uint8Array subview transfer bug in the encryption worker service.
summary.outcome: All 7 PR threads were resolved and pushed. The subview guard was added to encrypt-worker.service.ts and committed. E2E tests were initiated on the correct port (5173) but results were not confirmed in the transcript.

repo: CORS is configured specifically for port 5173; running the web dev server on any other port (e.g. 5174) will cause E2E test failures.
Shared types between worker files were extracted to encrypt.types.ts as part of thread 5 resolution.
The optimistic onFileComplete call in client.ts:908-909 is intentional for UX — error handler is responsible for cleanup, not a bug.

code.finding: worker.postMessage transferred params.data.buffer directly; if params.data is a subview (byteOffset !== 0 or byteLength !== buffer.byteLength), this detaches the entire underlying ArrayBuffer. Fixed with a guard: if subview, use params.data.slice().buffer instead of params.data.buffer, preserving Transferable[] only for full-buffer transfers.
fileKey was not cleared on all exit paths; a finally block was added to ensure cleanup regardless of success or error.
External fileKey was not cleared in the catch block when pinning or metadata operations threw; fixed to ensure cleanup on error.

workflow: Verify current code state before applying any suggested fix — some reported issues may already be moot given actual call paths (e.g. arrayBuffer() always produces a non-subview Uint8Array in practice).
When killing a dev server, also kill any stale processes on related ports before restarting to avoid CORS mismatches.

friction: E2E tests were initially started on port 5174 instead of 5173, causing a CORS failure and requiring a restart.
The first E2E run had to be interrupted mid-run after the port mismatch was identified.
Two separate processes needed to be killed (5173 and 5174) before the correct server could be started.
open_items: E2E test results on localhost:5173 + staging API were not confirmed in the transcript — outcome unknown.
The subview guard in encrypt-worker.service.ts is defensive; no current caller passes a subview, but the public API allows it — worth adding a test covering the subview path.
